title: UAT timeline
description: Schedule starts Monday 26 October 2026. Internal execution is Wednesday 28 October. Client UAT starts the week of 2 November.

items.Milestone: Finish test case design by owner
items.Owner: Josh, Kent, Chan, Howard and Gavin
items.Done when: 76-case baseline reviewed by each owner and paired reviewer; source mappings and retained follow-ups recorded. Review is not implied by the merge.

items.Milestone: Receive code from Dev; map data and check readiness
items.Done when: Rule answers due 27 Oct by 11:00, before Dev handover. Then verify build, accounts, mapped data, reset/fault controls and shared clock windows; name unresolved gates.

items.Milestone: Run all UAT cases and finish results
items.Done when: Target all 76 cases with Pass, Fail or Blocked and linked evidence. Log defects, do not fix them. Missing time stays Not Run and is reported as incomplete; never call it Blocked. This is internal execution, not client acceptance.
Internal results, defects and open gates are handed over; client UAT is tracked separately.
